messages:
Ajay: Quick sanity run of the toolcall+JSON path with the replay harness — seeing ~18% p95 tail increase when KV cache hits drop <40%. Ran with synthetic mix: 70% chat, 20% toolcall, 10% embeddings.

Maria: Can you paste the exact command + commit? I want to reproduce locally.

Ajay: run_replay.py --config tests/replay/toolcall_json.yaml --kv-target 0.35 --kernelselect=auto --batch-timeout-ms=12 --trace
Commit: ab3f9c4
Attached perf snippets below.

Ajay: ```
perf: tokens/s: 12.3k
p50: 45ms p95: 420ms p99: 760ms
kv_cache_hit: 0.33
kernel_selected: cuda_fused_attn_v2
batch_size_avg: 6.8
```

Kevin: Hm kernel_selected looks fine. Could be batching heuristic — when KV hit low, requests hotspot splits and we lose batch packing. Did you try relaxing batch-timeout?

Ajay: yes, +20ms reduces p95 to 360ms but drops throughput 6%.

Eva: Also saw JSON validation failures triggering retries in the replay logs — toolcall validator is currently strict; failed 0.7% of calls and retried -> extra load. Example: missing optional `metadata` field.

Maria: That could explain p99s. Can you grep for `validation_failed` in trace? Also check the retry backoff config (defaults to 50ms jitter).

Ajay: grepped. validation_failed shows up ~0.6% and majority originated from the 'structured-json' test bucket. We added a new stricter schema in PR #4123 yesterday (cc @Kevin).

Kevin: ack. I'll revert schema or add lenient mode to replay. But we should also quantify kernel switch overhead — when kernel selector chooses fallback kernel (non-fused), latency spikes ~120ms per request.

Ajay: Exactly, I added a micro-benchmark: `kernel-switch-bench --from fused_v2 --to naive_attn --batch 8` -> extra 95-130ms depending on seq len.

Eva: For apples-to-apples comparison, suggest: 1) pin kernel selector to baseline, 2) force KV hit rates via replay harness header, 3) run 3x seeds of 30m each. Record tokens/s and p95 with same load generators.

Maria: Agree. Also log `kernelselect.debug` at level INFO only during runs to avoid noise.

infra-bot: benchmark-run-complete: id=br-20260311-1801456789 status=partial
results: https://ci.redwood/example/br-1801456789
summary: kv=0.33 tokens/s=12.1k p95=398ms retries=0.7%

Kevin: Looks consistent. Next steps: (1) revert strict schema in replay harness; (2) instrument kernel selector to emit why it picked fallback; (3) try preferring same-seq batching to improve packing when kv misses.

Ajay: I'll run two longer replays with schema lenient and with same-seq heuristic, post results.

Maria: Thanks. If Ajay is blocked, assign to me.
